components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode"
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured address lines are supplied this is the composed, normalized value.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The primary postal address line. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional secondary postal address line, appended to the composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.E164NationalLength"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.NonDisposableEmail"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-04'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, an ageBand is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creation even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (MR, MRS, MS or DR) used to compose the salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The title and last name joined by a space, or just the last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR who'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Unified member identifier formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' from the region, the 2-digit fiscal year, the 8 upper-hex SHA-256 over (normalized telephone + last name), and a Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key joining the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the household id with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity key matches.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "Fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar year it ends in."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of owners that already shared this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) when it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Membership points assigned on creation: starts at 0, adds 2 when an email is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2 for a household of 3 or more and adds 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "IANA timezone derived from the region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane)."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "Segment formatted <TIER>_<AREA>: TIER is 'PREMIUM' at membershipLevel 3 or more else 'STANDARD', and AREA is 'METRO' for a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD) else 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration date at the time it was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the 50 capacity limit) at the time it was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              default: false
              example: false
              readOnly: true

            selfLink:
